integrity: Statements distinguish the new exhaustive infinite-family classification from the previously tabulated examples 30 and 105. The independent group-theoretic assertion that pqr groups are not simple is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only squarefree integers with at most three distinct prime factors are classified; no assertion about nonsquarefree or larger-support numbers; completeness is an elementary unconditional proof and no independent audit was performed.
title: Two squarefree three-prime survivors of the Sylow divisor condition
